After the reset of the self-adaptive par.zh: 自适应参数复位、断开电瓶或控制单元编程维修后，记得执行空调学习流程（钥匙打到 MAR、空调开启并保持一分钟）。
After the reset of the self-adaptive par.en: After the reset of the self-adaptive parameters, or after workshop repairs with disconnection of battery or control unit reprogramming, remember to carry out climate control learn procedure (key on MAR with climate control on for one minute).

DO NOT INTERRUPT the procedure once it h.zh: ⚠ 一旦开始不要中断。钥匙 ON、发动机 OFF。执行完成后将钥匙打到 OFF 并等待至少 60 秒再上电。注意：部分车型（Giulia / Stelvio）的 ABS 模块可能在 PROXI 过程中被复位，完成后需连接 ABS 模块执行全部标定流程（转向角、加速度、胎压）。
DO NOT INTERRUPT the procedure once it h.en: DO NOT INTERRUPT the procedure once it has started. The key should be ON/MAR and Engine OFF. After successfull execution of the procedure turn your key to OFF and wait at least 60 seconds before turning it back ON.  NOTE: On some models (GIULIA, STELVIO) the ABS module may be reset during PROXI procedure. You will have to connect to ABS mnodule and perform all calibration procedures.

Make sure that the vehicle is in park/ge.en: Make sure that the vehicle is in park/gear and will not move when parking brake is released!!!

You will also need to enter the electron.zh: 执行本功能还需输入车辆的电子钥匙码（可向官方服务站或经销商索取）。注意：连续 3 次输错，车身电脑将锁定 30 分钟。执行时车辆应为熄火状态——不要按 START 按钮上电或启动！可在模拟模式下先熟悉流程。执行后：断开 OBD 线，下车测试全部遥控钥匙是否有效。
You will also need to enter the electron.en: You will also need to enter the electronic key code of your vehicle in order to execute this function. You can request this code from official service or dealer. Please be careful and note that the Body Computer will block itself for 30 minutes after an incorrect code is entered 3 times.  The procedure should be executed with car turned OFF - you should not press the START button to switch ON or start the car!  NOTE: You may run this procedure in simulation mode to see how it works.  After the procedure: Disconnect the OBD cable, go out of car and test if all FOBIKs work.

DO NOT RUN this procedure if you don't k.zh: ⚠ 不熟悉流程请勿执行——本流程可能使钥匙失效！务必准备全部钥匙（所有钥匙都需重新编程）。执行本功能还需输入车辆的电子钥匙码（可向官方服务站/经销商索取）；连续 3 次输错车身电脑将锁定 30 分钟。执行时车辆应为熄火状态，不要按 START 上电或启动。流程：1. 启动流程；2. 按提示准备 1 号遥控钥匙并短暂按下 UNLOCK 键，系统确认识别；3. 依此插入 2 号及以后的钥匙，最多 8 把；4. 系统把识别到的钥匙写入射频中心模块（RFH）并显示结果（第 4 步前仍可中止并恢复原钥匙数据）。注意：未在流程中学习的钥匙将被禁用，无法解锁或启动车辆，可用「启用遥控钥匙」流程恢复。执行后：断开 OBD 线，下车测试全部遥控钥匙是否有效。
DO NOT RUN this procedure if you don't k.en: DO NOT RUN this procedure if you don't know what you are doing as this procedure may disable your keys! Make sure YOU HAVE ALL KEYS as you will have to program ALL of them.  WARNING: You will also need to enter the electronic key code of your vehicle in order to execute this function. You can request this code from official service or dealer. Please be careful and note that the Body Computer will block itself for 30 minutes after an incorrect code is entered 3 times.  The procedure should be executed with car turned OFF - you should not press the START button to switch ON or start the car!  NOTE: You may run this procedure in simulation mode to see how it works. Basically, you have to do the following:  1. Start the procedure  2. The system will ask you to prepare FOBIK 1 and click Y. After that you have to press the UNLOCK button on the FOBIK briefly once and wait. The system will confirm if the recognition of the FOBIK is successfull.  3. The system will ask you to insert FOBIK 2 and so on. This procedure can be repeated for up to 8 FOBIKs.  4. The system will finally store all recognized keys into the Radio Frequency Hub module (RFH) and will display a status of the whole procedure. You will still have a chance to abort the procedure before step 4 and restore the previous FOBIK data.  PLEASE NOTE that the FOBIKs not learned during the procedure will be disabled and it will not be possible to use them to unlock or start the car. These FOBIKs can be re-enabled by using the "Enable FOBIKs" procedure.  After the procedure: Disconnect the OBD cable, go out of car and test if all FOBIKs work.
